runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 15.9.2026 00:11 sweep across 13 source families. No new candidate cleared the current LIVE threshold. LinkedIn exposed current Bratislava support roles including Wolt and a fresh Siemens Healthineers ServiceNow support listing, but Wolt requires minimum B2 English and the Siemens result was only index-level evidence without enough verified detail for promotion. Upwork re-exposed WooCommerce data-entry work at $35 fixed with 20-50 proposals, which is too weak economically for promotion. StartupJobs surfaced a senior backend/AI role at 4,500-6,000 EUR, rejected as hard-development mismatch. Reddit results were freelancer self-promotion rather than client demand. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion or unsafe canonical replacement was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Index-only candidate evidence cap
developmentChanges.reason: Cap ranking confidence for candidates seen only in search/category indexes until a full canonical detail confirms language, location, workload and application status. This prevents fresh snippets from outranking fully verified roles.

developmentChanges.title: Low-budget freelance auto-suppress
developmentChanges.reason: For fixed-price freelance jobs, combine budget, proposal count and likely task scope into an automatic low-value suppression rule. This saves review time on superficially relevant WooCommerce jobs whose expected effective hourly return is too weak.
